## Checklist

- [ ] My catalog is publicly reachable over HTTPS without authentication.
- [ ] `ai-catalog validate` reports no errors for my catalog.
- [ ] My catalog has at least one entry and isn't already listed (directly or as a nested catalog).
- [ ] I added one entry to `ai-catalog.json`, in alphabetical order by `displayName`, and didn't edit the README list.
- [ ] If I used a `urn:air` identifier, I'm the publisher and its domain matches my catalog URL.
